warm_up:
Activation & Mobilisation Drills:
1 round
Warm Up
10 Scap Push Ups
10 scap Pull ups
10 x Inch Worms
10 I-Y-T-W
10 Leg Raise holding rig
Wrist Mobilisation
Banded Pull Aparts x 10
5 x PVC Pipe Around the world
gymnastics:
Tabata 20 seconds on - 10 seconds off x 4 mins (00:00)
Hollow & Arch Hold
Rope Climb Progression (05:00-20:00)
Every 90s x 10
Level 1
Sit on Box & find J-Hook - stand Up
Level 2
1 Partial Climb off the ground
Aim for less pulls each time to get there - Lean back & get feet to hands
Level 3
Full height Rope Climb
Aim to get there in the least amount of pulls as possible
T2B Bar Progression
1-2 mins False Grip on bar - focus on Knuckles Up (21:00)
EMOM x 3 (23:00)
10 x Beat Swing
EMOM x 3 (26:00)
Bigger Beat Swing - Push Down on Bar
- Put Ball between feet - Reach Long in the Arch - Dont bend the knees
EMOM x 3 (29:00)
Knees to Chest - Aggressive & Pop - pause at the top
EMOM x 3 (32:00)
Beat Swing with Straight legs - to target
Aim for height without losing tension.
the goal is to chain them together
EMOM x 3 (35:00)
Aggressive Knees to chest - with toe flick

hypertrophy.reasoning: Today heavily taxes core, shoulders, and pulling. Address pressing patterns and horizontal back work to balance.
